title: Arduino LED Blink
description: Learn the fundamentals of Arduino programming by blinking an LED. Perfect first project for embedded systems beginners.
shortDescription: Classic Hello World for Arduino — blink an LED with digitalWrite.

title: Raspberry Pi LED Blink
description: Blink a physical LED on BCM GPIO17 using gpiozero on a Linux Raspberry Pi. Includes wiring instructions in examples/README.md.
shortDescription: Python GPIO blink with a current-limiting resistor.

title: Arduino Button Input
description: Connect a push button between D2 and GND. The sketch enables the internal pull-up, so D2 reads LOW while the button is pressed. Runs in the Studio Uno emulator and prints the state over serial.
shortDescription: Read a push button with INPUT_PULLUP and light the built-in LED.

title: Arduino Potentiometer Dimmer
description: A potentiometer between 5V and GND feeds analogRead on A0; the value is mapped to analogWrite on D9 to dim an LED through a 330 Ω resistor. In Studio you can drag a slider while the sketch runs and measure the 490 Hz PWM duty cycle.
shortDescription: Read a potentiometer on A0 and dim an LED with PWM on D9.
